text.tspan: Threshold income per day marking the poorest decile, the median, and
The level of income per person per day below which 10%, 50% and 90% of the population falls. Income here is measured
after taxes and benefits. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.

tspan.tspan: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Income has been equivalized.
